headline: BTCS Warns SEC of Liquidation Risk on $54 Million Aave Loan
summary: Ether treasury firm BTCS warned the SEC that its $54 million loan on DeFi platform Aave faces liquidation risk. The company reduced its debt by about $10 million in ten days, but falling ether prices continue to pressure its collateral.
why: BTCS Inc. is a U.S.-based company focused on blockchain technology, digital asset treasury management, and staking infrastructure.

impacts.name: BTCS Inc.
impacts.why: BTCS disclosed to regulators that its loan collateral faces liquidation risk from declining ether prices.
